title: Entangled Parts
subtitle: Ingots, wire and coils
text:
Entangled parts start with the Entangled Ingot, alloyed from redstone copper and an ender pearl in the Alloy Smelter. The Rolling Mill in rod mode turns each ingot into 2 Entangled Wire.

Wire wound on a steel rod makes an Entangled Coil. Entangled Buffers, Tanks and Backpacks are built from them.
